title: ASMR Latex Sounds (Standard)
description: For this file I want you to come join me down in my recording studio dungeon, while I attempt to make some slippery sound effects with my latex skirt. As I do a little bit of a behind the scenes tease of my upcoming file, "The Choice is Yours", with some sexy mind-altering spoilers. Though of course, it'll make things more fun for us both if I also drop you down into trance — letting slip the idea that my whispers and the effects I make will fractionate you back and forth to wakefulness. But. Before we get started on all that. I'll first need to clean down my sticky microphone. You don't want me completely breaking your immersion by screaming out — "ewwwww!" — when I want to come in close and play, now do you? Or maybe, just maybe, some of you slutty perverts secretly do.
author: Mistress Shibby
